items.title: The chain-reaction era: Constant shock and awe
items.summary: It was random, but related, that we were hit with a tectonic election result, an epic AI-and-spy scandal, and the dramatic FAA shutdown in just over one week.This is our new reality: constant shock and awe, igniting chain reactions across politics, media, AI, business and culture.Why it matters: This month's three shocks hit separately. But their speed and spread are our new reality.Politics, AI,

items.title: Intel sued by investors after PC sales slump hits share price
items.summary: A proposed class action claims the firm hid the impact of slowing PC sales from shareholders.
